title: Quantize vectors with codebooks, residuals, and grids
brief: Build nearest-codeword lookup, the straight-through estimator and VQ losses, EMA codebooks with dead-code restart, residual vector quantization, and finite scalar quantization.
hints: Squared distances without an (N, K, D) array: (z**2).sum(1, keepdims=True) - 2 * z @ C.T + (C**2).sum(1)[None, :].
The straight-through estimator is one line: z_e + (z_q - z_e).detach(). Its value is z_q and its gradient is the identity.
In vq_losses the two losses have the same value and differ only in where .detach() goes: the codebook loss detaches z_e, the commitment loss detaches the codeword.
For ema_update, np.bincount(indices, minlength=K) counts assignments and np.add.at(batch_sums, indices, z) sums the assigned vectors.
In rvq_encode, keep a running residual: quantize it, add the codeword to the reconstruction, subtract it from the residual, and record np.linalg.norm(residual, axis=1).
